utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the exact time and drop-off spot, so I don’t want to guess and make a wasted trip. Once that’s set, I can plan around it and bring what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense. Once you get the time and drop-off spot, let me know and I’ll plan around it too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sounds good — I’ll wait for the exact details and then I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds like they’re in good shape, mostly just sorting donations and filling the last few volunteer spots. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything specific comes up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep spreading the word and send over anything I hear. If you spot any last volunteer gaps, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Quinn — I will. Thanks for helping spread the word, and I’ll let you know if I hear about any last gaps.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—that’d be great. I’m still catching up on everything, so I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — I’ll spread the word and tell people to bring any small broken items they want fixed. Saturday at 9, and I’ll let everyone know there’ll be volunteers on hand.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps a lot — Saturday at 9 works for me. I’ll keep an ear out and pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive plans. You just take it easy today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate that. I’ll swing by and help where I can, even if I’m late.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’s great, Dane — I’ll let everyone know you’re coming by to help with the repair drive plans.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara—that helps. When does the repair drive start, and what tools or supplies do you already have?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ve got my toolbox and I can check the loose railings on Maple. I’ll also ask around for extra screws or paint.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks, Bo. When is the repair drive starting, and should I bring anything specific beyond my own basic tools?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — thanks, Bo. If you can check the Maple railings and pass along any extra screws or paint you find, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, is it really getting help already? What’s still left to do?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: A few things are still open — we could use more hands for small fixes, supplies like screws and paint, and help letting neighbors know. I’m keeping a list so we can match people to what they can do.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, the community center parking lot at 2:00 PM works for me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, I’ll meet you at the community center parking lot at 2:00 PM.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, I’ll see you there at 2:00 PM.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 9 should work for me. I’ll make sure it fits around the school schedule and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Saturday at 9 works. Do you know what items they’re collecting for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m not sure yet, but I can check and let you know. I’ll see what they need and make sure it fits around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Opal — that’d be a big help. I’ll let you know if I hear anything too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s at the community center parking lot, starting at 2:00 PM. If you hear any location changes, just send them my way and I’ll keep it updated.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — community center parking lot at 2:00 PM. I’ll pass along any changes if I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like it’s coming together nicely. I’ll keep checking around and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’m a bit all over the place today, so that helps.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mara — if you know what’s already covered, I’ll keep the list updated from there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’ve got volunteers lined up, and people should bring any small broken items they want fixed. If you can keep the list updated from there, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep track of the small-item list and note that volunteers are set. Just let me know if anything else gets covered or is still needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll drop off the hammer, screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measure this afternoon. Just let me know if you need anything else for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — that should cover it. I’ll bring the screws and basic tools, and I can help with the gate patch too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Leo — I appreciate it. I’ll see you this afternoon with the tools and we can tackle the gate patch together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll make sure everyone hears the repair drive plans. You just take it easy today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate that. If you can point anyone my way with extra screws or paint, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll pass that along and point anyone with extra screws or paint your way.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 10:00 sharp works for me. I’ll be ready and we can head over then.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great—10:00 sharp works for me too. Just send me the exact drop-off details so I don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s the community center parking lot, and it starts at 2:00 PM. We’ll head over at 10:00 sharp, so it should be easy.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. I can help a little, but I’ll need to keep it simple today.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That makes sense—simple is good. I’ll keep it brief when I mention it around the block.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. I appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Kira — I’ll keep an ear out too, and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — please do. And if you hear the exact time and drop-off spot, let me know so I don’t guess wrong.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — if I hear the time and drop-off spot, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring screws and basic tools, and I can help patch the gate too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds great, Leo. The gate patch will really help, and I’ll keep an eye out for any small fixes too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll bring the screws and tools and help with the gate patch.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Saturday at 9 sounds good to me. I’ll spread the word about bringing small broken items and that volunteers will be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, Jules — I’ll keep an ear out for any updates while I’m out running errands. Thanks for spreading the word!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’ll let folks know Saturday at 9 and remind them to bring any small broken items.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That sounds right up my alley — I can bring the hammer, screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measure later this afternoon. If you want, I can also help sort the jobs into what needs a handyman and what needs an electrician.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be great, Gus—thank you. I’m organizing it with the neighborhood committee, and the main fixes are the broken fence and a few porch steps around the block.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, I can help sort those out. I’ll bring the tools this afternoon and we can make a quick list for the fence and porch steps.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mina — if you know what’s already covered, I can update my list and see what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m not sure what’s covered yet either. I’ll check the flyer or announcement and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mina — that’d help a lot. I’ll keep the list ready and wait to hear what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s at the community center parking lot, starting at 2:00 PM. If anything changes, just let me know and I’ll note it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything changes or if I hear what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep tracking the location and time, and note any updates.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn. I’m a bit all over the place today, so that helps.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send over the details and timing right away. And if you want, I can pass your name along too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — please pass my name along too. I appreciate you sending the details; I’m a little scattered today.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring my drill and a couple screwdrivers and be there around 10.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 9 still works for me—I’ll keep it around the school schedule and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — Saturday at 9 works for me too. Just let me know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Hana, I’m here late as usual, but I can still help with the repair drive. Just point me to whatever’s still needed and I’ll jump in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane. I’d want to check the flyer first—what date does the repair drive start, and who’s organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not sure on the exact date or organizer yet, but I can check the flyer and get back to you. For now, I’m happy to help with whatever’s still needed.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
